question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, name, total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points) as point_rank
    FROM constructor_totals
    WHERE total_points > 0
)
SELECT constructor_id, name, COUNT(*) as lowest_season_count
FROM ranked
WHERE point_rank = 1
GROUP BY constructor_id, name
ORDER BY lowest_season_count DESC, name
LIMIT 5
